title: Container Bookings: late VGM free allowance on dangerous-goods bookings
content:
## Rule
For a late verified gross mass on a Container Bookings booking, the free allowance is open for every booking whose cargo category is not dangerous goods. A booking whose cargo category is dangerous goods has it only when at least one of its dangerous-goods acceptances is approved with a positive container count.

Whether an acceptance is approved, and for how many containers, is taken from the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance records.

## Condition table
| Cargo category of the booking | Approved dangerous-goods acceptance with a positive container count | Free allowance |
|---|---|---|
| not dangerous goods | not relevant | open |
| dangerous goods | at least one | open |
| dangerous goods | none | closed; a late VGM is at the full fee |
